label: opencode
notes: Primary source: GET /console/api/request-logs?category=inference&limit=100&since=<ms>&cursor=…&until=… from the signed-in Console tab (session cookie + x-org-id header). One record per succeeded inference request, newest-first; cursor must be sent with the previous page's until. Retention is ~30d, so a full sync covers the window, and an incremental sync stops once a page reaches the newest stored record.

Provides input, output, reasoning, cacheRead, cacheWrite (single bucket; no 5m/1h split), provider, an optional API-key id, app, session id, and the Console-charged amount (cost, microcents scale). No billing source — free rows are cost 0 and rejected rows carry no cost key; non-succeeded and non-inference rows are skipped.
Missing: no billing source — records carry the org id instead of a workspace id; free rows are cost 0 and there is no free/BYOK tag.
Cost: the Console-charged amount when present (costScale 1e8, unit to be pinned by a paid sample), otherwise estimated from the price table (or re-priced under unified pricing).
Needs a signed-in Console tab; auto-sync (opencode only) reuses an open Console tab, or opens a background one, every 6h.
A local DB import (tools/import-local.mjs) lands in localImportData and serves models the server no longer reports (e.g. free models).
